rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_11: Golden Locking Respins: The Caishen symbol acts as a multiplier collection symbol.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_12: Collect Multiplier Symbol: If a Caishen symbol appears on the screen, it collects all Yuanbao bonuses and adds them to itself, then applies an additional multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, x15, x16, x17, x18, x19, or up to x20.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_14: These three symbols are Jackpot symbols and appear on all reels.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_20: This symbol is a mystery symbol that appears in the main game and the Golden Lock Respin.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_26: Each time the Golden Lock Respin is triggered, you will receive 3 spins. If any of {img0}, {img1}, {img2}, {img3}, {img4}, {img5}, {img6}, {img7}, and {img8} appear, the spins will be reset to 3 again.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_29: Click the OFF→ON button for extra bets to open the "Spec Selection Screen".
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_30: Choose one of the 3 available options.  After selecting, click "Confirm" to activate the additional bet effect.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_31: Use 1.5x bets to double your chances of entering the Golden Lock Respin!
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_33: Use 6x bet to increase the chance of entering  the Golden Lock Respin by 8x! In the base game, the Caishen symbol comes with X2, and after collection, grants an additional X2.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_34: Extra bets payout = Base bet amount x Odds!
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_39: In the base game, paylines 1-3 must start from the leftmost reel, with 3 or more consecutive symbols from left to right. Paylines 4-6 must start from the rightmost reel, with 3 or more consecutive symbols from right to left. Symbols do not need to be the same.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_43: Feature games use the same bet as the game of triggering spin.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_7: This symbol is the symbol of the Caishen, which will appear in all slots.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_8: In the main game, it serves as both a collection symbol and a SCATTER symbol.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_10: SCATTER Symbol: If one Caishen symbol lands in the center position, you will enter the Golden Lock Respin. Before entering, the Caishen symbol collects all Yuanbao bonuses on the screen and carries them into the Golden Lock Respin. If there are no Yuanbao symbols to collect, the Caishen symbol will become a multiplier collection symbol once the Golden Lock Respin begins.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_15: The Jackpot prize is a fixed multiplier x the player’s bet amount:
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_2: These three symbols are yuanbao symbols, and the bonus will be displayed above. The bonus calculation method is Player Bet Amount x Multiplier. Different yuanbao symbols correspond to the following multipliers:
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_21: Main Game: Appearing on the winning line will randomly award yuanbao symbol or Jackpot prizes.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_22: Golden Lock Respin: If the Mystery Symbol appears during the Golden Lock Respin, it will randomly reveal a Yuanbao or Jackpot prize before the final settlement. If a Mystery Symbol appears in the main game and triggers the Golden Lock Respin, it carries over into the Golden Lock Respin.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_24: This symbol is the Jackpot Mystery symbol, which only appears during the Golden Lock Respins. It will reveal itself before the settlement and will only reveal the Jackpot symbol.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_27: During the lock respin, If all reel positions are filled with any symbol,  a Full Reel Reward {txt0}, which is a fixed {txt1} multiplier of the player’s bet will be awarded. The maximum possible win in a single Golden Lock Respin is 5000x, and no additional payout is calculated for the symbols on the reels once this reward is granted.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_32: Use 3x bet to increase the chance of entering  the Golden Lock Respin by 4x! In the base game, the Caishen symbol comes with X2, and after collection, grants an additional X2.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_35: The base bet amount differs between Extra Bet and regular bets.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_36: Click the "Extra Bet" ON→OFF button to deactivate the extra bet feature.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_38: This is a 3-row, 5-reel slot game with a fixed 6 paylines.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_41: Only the highest win per line is paid. When achieving a 5-symbol win, only one winning line is counted.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_42: If there are multiple winning lines, all wins are summed.
rules.i18_INTRO_MPT2_9: Collect symbols: If the Caishen symbol appears on a winning payline, it collects all Yuanbao bonuses on the screen and adds them to itself, without removing the Yuanbao bonuses.
